turns.question: What was our win rate on the search leads that came in during September 2026?
turns.answer: Taking "win rate" as the lead-to-booking rate (the share of leads that booked within 30 days of being created), 33.7% of the search-channel leads created from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 booked. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
